Extremely even, shadow-free cross-polarized diffuse illumination: skin pores, subtle pigmentation, soft natural lip colour, eyelid skin detail, but NO cast shadows, NO baked nose/eye-socket shadow, NO shine or painted catchlights, NO depth of field. The painting will be sampled onto actual 3D geometry; use restrained realistic local colours, not dramatic shading. Maintain plausible adult human proportions and natural bilateral symmetry, while making an appealing original identity. No likeness to any real person, actor or existing game character. Keep the whole crown, ears and chin inside the square with small margins. Clean shaven. Dark brown irises. No makeup. Natural medium warm skin. A calm confident neutral expression. Keep eyebrows subtle enough that existing geometric eyebrows can remain visible.
